fields.description: Issue includes prominent coverage of allegations against Dr. T. Earl Moore, described as Miami's "Torture Doctor," including a letter attributed to ex-patient Colin Drake and discussion of patient suicides and related calls for official action. It also features editorials and reports opposing racetracks and gambling (including mention of Gamblers Anonymous), local and state politics such as proposals to recall Florida legislators over a sales tax, and local civic/government news including City Commissioner Howard Leslie Quigg's re-election campaign remarks. Additional items address labor developments affecting Miami newspapers, police and court incidents, and columns on national defense planning and other commentary.
